# Yusuf Terzioglu — AI Software Architect

Canonical URL: https://yusufterzioglu.com/
Last updated: 2026-08-31
Language: English
Location: Istanbul, Turkey

## Identity

Yusuf Terzioglu, also written Yusuf Terzioğlu and known online as terzigolu, is an AI software architect with more than 10 years of engineering experience and more than 7 years of React Native experience. His work covers AI-driven SaaS, large language model orchestration, AI agent infrastructure, full-stack web products, mobile applications, IoT, and embedded systems.

## Featured products

### SentScan

URL: https://sentscan.com

SentScan is a multi-model AI SaaS product for analyzing large volumes of YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok conversations. The portfolio describes Gemini, Claude, and OpenAI pipelines, hybrid caching, cost-aware model routing, and brand sentiment insights. The portfolio reports more than 500,000 comments processed.

Technologies named on the portfolio: Next.js 15, Supabase, Redis, BullMQ, and multi-model LLM systems.

### Ramorie

URL: https://ramorie.com

Ramorie is an AI agent memory and task-management platform focused on continuity across agent workflows. The portfolio describes persistent memory, knowledge graphs, entity extraction, procedural skills, MCP orchestration, a Go CLI, PostgreSQL, Redis, and a Next.js workspace.

## Current work

### Turna.com

URL: https://www.turna.com/

Yusuf currently works at Turna.com as a Senior Software Engineer and has done so for 4 months as of 2026-08-31. His portfolio describes this work as building and improving the travel platform's customer-facing mobile application experience.

## Previous experience

### Ork Digital

Yusuf worked at Ork Digital from 2025 to 2026 in senior software engineering and R&D. His portfolio describes architecture work across SentScan and Ramorie, including multi-model AI pipelines, agent memory, knowledge graphs, caching, billing, and production operations.
